name: Radar tower
description: Square galvanised lattice radar tower, 5.6 m on plan and 17.8 m to its top deck, carrying a white radome (about 21.7 m overall). Four box legs on concrete footings with girts every 3 m and X-bracing, a caged steel switchback stair (ten flights of eight risers with landings and handrails) up the west side to a chequer-plate intermediate platform at 9 m and a top platform at 15 m under the radome deck; guard rails all round, louvred screening panels on part of the top platform's edge, equipment cabinets and cable trays.
